title: Fulfillments
description: Track shipments and delivery of product orders.

help.title: About fulfillments
help.overview: A fulfillment is one parcel of an order: which items left, with which carrier and tracking number. Ship order creates one for you; create one here to send an order in several parcels.

sections.title: Create a parcel
items: Pick the order, then the items and how many of each. Only what hasn't shipped yet can go in.
A new parcel is Pending: nothing has left and stock is unchanged. Carrier, tracking and dates stay editable.

sections.title: Follow it
items: Mark as shipped needs a confirmed order. It takes the items out of stock, or is refused if stock is short, and sends the customer the carrier and tracking link.
Mark as delivered when it arrives. Once every parcel has arrived, the order becomes Delivered and the customer is told.
Mark as failed for a parcel that was lost or came back: its items return to stock, kept for the order, so you can send a new parcel.
Payment, cancelling and refunds stay on the order, under Product orders.
